text:
Auxiliaries | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction 
 Should be compared with CP-007
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection check list PI, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block
The 
technical specifications of the air compressor. Stationary, three stage, single 
acting one crank, air cooled machine 180m3/h, 40hg/cm2
The 
first draft is initiated & reviewed by eng. Nagy Bekheit Saleh,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Wear safety equipment`s, helmet
Switch off the A.C current
Close the outlet valve
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Wear safety equipment`s, helmet
Switch off the A.C current
Close the outlet valve
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet
Safety helmet
Cleaning materials (cloth - kerosene)
Tool set
Work to be Carried Out
In addition to the work done in, 
(P3-M6) do the following
Replacement of connecting rods dig end bushing if required
Replacement of bushings with subsequent boring of the piston 
 and crosshead bosses
Grind the piston pin surface
Replace the gaskets
Replace the cylinders, pistons, and pistons ring by new ones 
 if required
Inspect, clean the pump gears
Repair and clean the cooler unit with soda
Inspect the compressor foundation
